fields.path: string - file path relative to repository root
fields.sha256: string - SHA-256 hash of file contents
fields.mime_type: string - MIME type of the file
fields.is_executable: boolean - whether the file has the executable bit set
fields.is_lfs_tracked: boolean - whether the file is tracked by Git LFS
fields.entropy: number - Shannon entropy score of file contents
fields.created_at: string - ISO8601 timestamp of first commit containing this file
fields.contributor_count: integer - number of unique contributors to this file

last_commit.sha: string - commit SHA of the last change to this file
last_commit.author: string - human-readable author name
last_commit.email: string - author email from Git log
last_commit.timestamp: string - ISO8601 timestamp of last modification
